structure.unit: Waters of the State, Ports and Harbors
Mills, Dams and Certain Other Works on Watercourses

law.catch_line: Such leave not to affect vested rights
law.text: No person shall by means of any such leave, draw the water from any millpond of another, existing at the time of such leave, or do anything in conflict with any vested right in any waterworks erected on such watercourse.
